content: Pauli ipala apelekwe kwa Nkolongwa jwa Loma
Pighapetita machiko matato Fesito ajhakubhoka ku Kaisaliya nu kujhenda ku Yeluchalemo.
Kola bhakolo bha Matambiko na ilongoche ya Akayahude bhajhakuntakalila Pauli palonge jhabhe, bhajhakumpembelekeya Fesito.
Abhatendele lijhambu lyambone kwa kumpeleka Pauli ku Yeluchalemo, nhwalo bhakatehi mpangu bhankome undela.
Nambo Fesito ajhakujhanguu, “Pauli nahighalika mukipungo koko ku Kaisaliya, na nenga nikilenganikiya kujhenda kwenio.
Bhahe, mwaleke ilongoche bhino tulongohane na nenga ku Kaisaliya na bhene bhakalongele matakalilo panane jhake anda kibhii kibhoho chalemwite.”
Fesito ajhakutama nabho kwa machiko nane amu kome, na ajhakubhujha ku Kaisaliya. Kilabho jhake ajhakutama nkate jha nyumba jha mihalo na kwalobholela bhannete Pauli palonge jhake.
Pubhanetita Pauli, Akayahude bhubhaumila ku Yeluchalemo bhala bhajhakuntindindila na kubhoha matakalilo ghamahele panane jha Pauli nambo bhakahotwi jhe kulangiya uchakaka gwenio.
Pauli kwa kukikengelela alongila, “Nenga ndei ndeka ulemo panane jha lilaghalikilo lya Akayahude, hilu panane jha Nyumba jha Chapanga, hilu panane jha munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.”
Fesito kwa kupala kubhehe nkoche jwa Akayahude, ajhakunkonya Pauli, “Bho, mipala kujhenda ku Yeluchalemo na kwenio mukahadabulwe palonge jhango?”
Pauli ajhakujhanguu, “Nenga nyemite palonge jha nyumba jha mihalo jha munahota nkolongwa Kaichale, ndi nipalwa kuhadabulwa pamba. Anda umanya hela, natenda ndeka kilebhe changanandela kwa Akayahude.

Bhahe, anda ngolilwe na ulemo ghumbala nenga ngomwe nikana ndeka kuwegha. Nambo anda matakalilo ghino ghuwange panane jhango, abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha nahotola kumbeleka kwabhe. Nipala nikahadabulwe kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.”
Bhahe, Fesito pajhomolila kulonge na bhando bha pa bwalo ghoha bhakujhanguu, “Nnyopite mukahadabulwe na munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma, nnyende koko.”
Fesito ilonge nako munahota nkolongwa Agilipa
Pighapetita machiko ghandina, munahota nkolongwa Agilipa na Belenike bhajhakuhika ku Kaisaliya kunyambucha Fesito.
Bhajhakutama kwenio kwa machiko ghamahele, na jwenio Fesito ajhakunnobholela munahota nkolongwa jhola mambu gha Pauli. Annobholila, “Pamba abhii mundo jhumo jwakabhekitwe mukipungo na Feliki.
Punyahwila ku Yeluchalemo, akapiya matambiko bhakolo na ighogholo ya Akayahude bhakantakalile na kunyopa nihadabule.
Nambo nenga nyakwajhanguu yambone jhe kwa Loma kupiya mundo jwatakalilwe palonge jha pa bwalo changakongana na bhando bhubhaletite matakalilo na jwenio akikengelele.
Bhahe, pubhahikita pamba nenga nikatamikii ndeka, na kilabho jhake nikatamite mihalo munyumba jha mihalo, nyakulaghalikiya mu mundo jwenio aletwe.
Na bhene bhubhantakalile pubhajhemita, bhakalongii ndeka malobhe mahaku ngita chihobholila.
Nambo kilebhe chimo tugha bhatehila kutaungana panane jha dine jhabhe na panane jha mundo jhumo jwakemitwa Yecho, nambo Pauli alongela Yecho akawile na ngoheno abhii ghome.
Na nenga manyite jhe chakuhenga panane jha litakalilo lyenio, bhahe, nyankonya Pauli anda ngapala kujhenda kunyumba jha mihalo ku Yeluchalemo kwa nhwalo gwa matakalilo gheniya.
Nambo Pauli apalita akahadabulwe na munahota nkolongwa Kaichale jwa ku Loma, na ajhakujhopa ahighalike papala. Na nenga nyakuneka papa ade pumbala kumpeleka kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.”
Bhahe, Agilipa ajhakunnobholela Fesito, “Na nenga nipala kunnyokanikiya mundo hojho hele.” Fesito ajhakujhanguu, “Chimunyokanikiya kilabho.”
Pauli palonge jha Agilipa na Belinike

Bhahe, kilabho jhake Agilipa pamonga na Belenike bhajhakuhika kwa ilulo hake na kujhingila ku chumbi cha chibhakonganika, pamonga na bhakolo bha akakomana ngondo na ilongoche ya muche. Fesito ajhakulaghalikiya Pauli bhannete nkate.

Peniya, Fesito ajhakulonge, “Munahota nkolongwa Agilipa, na mabhoha bhumii pamo na twenga. Palonge jhino abhii mundo jhonjo! Akayahude bhoha bha ku Yeluchalemo na bhamba bha ku Kaisaliya bhachobhelela kubhehe mundo ipalwa akomwe.
Nambo nenga nikahwe ndeka chatehi changanandela hote itopela akomwe. Nambo Pauli jwenio apalita akahadabulwe kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma, na nenga jwakulaghalikiya bhampeleke koko ku Loma.

Nenga ngwete jhe malobhe gha chakaka ghinihoto kunyandikila munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma panane jhake. Ndi mana ninetite palonge jhino na palonge jha mwe munahota nkolongwa Agilipa, pumujhomolela kulingukiya nambata malobhe gha kujhandika.
Nhwalo lyambone jhe kuntabha mukipungo changamanya hotuhotu chatakalilwe nacho.”
